parts.zh: M：谢谢你今晚邀请我出来
W：我也一直特别想来这里
W：嗯，也不完全是。我一点肉都不吃
M：这不是很难吗？我无法想象放弃上等的多汁牛排或培根芝士汉堡
W：我也不知道。我父母遵循的也是同样的饮食习惯
M：我更难想象没有咖啡的你
M：这样的话，也许哪天我会试试看

items.stem: Where does the conversation most probably take place?

choices.text: In a restaurant.
choices.zh: 在餐馆里。

choices.text: In a kitchen.
choices.zh: 在厨房里。

choices.text: In a food store.
choices.zh: 在食品店里。

choices.text: In a supermarket.
choices.zh: 在超市里。

items.stem: What do we learn about the woman?

choices.text: She eats meat occasionally.
choices.zh: 她偶尔吃肉。

choices.text: She enjoys cheeseburgers.
choices.zh: 她喜欢吃芝士汉堡。

choices.text: She is allergic to seafood.
choices.zh: 她对海鲜过敏。

choices.text: She is a partial vegetarian.
choices.zh: 她是一位部分素食者。

items.stem: What would be a difficult thing to do according to the woman?

choices.text: Dealing with one's colleagues.
choices.zh: 与同事打交道。

choices.text: Changing one's eating habit.
choices.zh: 改变饮食习惯。

choices.text: Following the same diet for years.
choices.zh: 多年保持同样的饮食。

choices.text: Keeping awake at morning meetings.
choices.zh: 在早晨会议上保持清醒。

items.stem: What does the woman say about her parents?

choices.text: They enjoy perfect health.
choices.zh: 他们身体非常健康。

choices.text: They are both animal lovers.
choices.zh: 他们都是动物爱好者。

choices.text: They only eat organic food.
choices.zh: 他们只吃有机食品。

choices.text: They are cutting back on coffee.
choices.zh: 他们正在减少咖啡摄入量。

items.stem: What was the manager's reason for giving little praise for the man's performance?

choices.text: The man got a poor evaluation from his colleagues.
choices.zh: 这名男士从同事那里得到了较差的评价。

choices.text: The man made little contribution to the company.
choices.zh: 这名男士对公司贡献甚微。

choices.text: The man paid attention to trivial things.
choices.zh: 这名男士关注琐碎的事情。

choices.text: The man had an attitude problem.
choices.zh: 这名男士有态度问题。

items.stem: What does the woman say about some managers?

choices.text: They make unhelpful decisions for solving problems.
choices.zh: 他们在解决问题时做出无益的决定。

choices.text: They favor some employees' suggestions over others.
choices.zh: 他们偏爱某些员工的建议而非其他人的建议。

choices.text: They use manipulative language to mask their irrational choices.
choices.zh: 他们使用操纵性语言来掩盖其不理性的选择。

choices.text: They reject employees' reasonable arguments for work efficiency.
choices.zh: 他们拒绝员工关于提高工作效率的合理论证。

items.stem: According to the woman, what do some managers think of honesty?

choices.text: It is a must for rational judgment.
choices.zh: 诚实是理性判断的必要条件。

choices.text: It is more of a sin than a virtue.
choices.zh: 诚实更像是一种罪过而非美德。

choices.text: It is a good quality in the workplace.
choices.zh: 诚实是职场中的一种良好品质。

choices.text: It is more important now than ever.
choices.zh: 诚实现在比以往任何时候都更重要。

items.stem: What does the woman think is the priority of many managers?

choices.text: Smoothing relationships in the workplace.
choices.zh: 协调职场中的关系。

choices.text: Making rational and productive decisions.
choices.zh: 做出理性且富有成效的决定。

choices.text: Focusing on employees career growth.
choices.zh: 关注员工的职业发展。

choices.text: Preserving their power and prestige.
choices.zh: 维护他们的权力和威望。

items.stem: Why does the speaker say athletes are often viewed as heroes?

choices.text: They show genius which defies description.
choices.zh: 他们展现了难以言表的天赋。

choices.text: They accomplish feats many of us cannot.
choices.zh: 他们完成了我们许多人无法做到的壮举。

choices.text: They create very high commercial value.
choices.zh: 他们创造了非常高的商业价值。

choices.text: They bring great honor to their country.
choices.zh: 他们为国家带来巨大荣誉。

items.stem: What does the speaker say many high-profile players do?

choices.text: They take part in kids' extra-curricular activities.
choices.zh: 他们参加孩子们的课外活动。

choices.text: They work in spare time to teach children sports.
choices.zh: 他们利用业余时间教孩子们体育运动。

choices.text: They try to be positive role models to children.
choices.zh: 他们努力成为孩子们的积极榜样。

choices.text: They serve as spokespersons for luxury goods.
choices.zh: 他们担任奢侈品的代言人。

items.stem: What does the speaker say can be difficult?

choices.text: Separating an athlete's professional life from their personal life.
choices.zh: 将运动员的职业生活与个人生活分开。

choices.text: Preventing certain athletes from getting in trouble with the law.
choices.zh: 防止某些运动员触犯法律。

choices.text: Keeping athletes away from drug or alcohol problems.
choices.zh: 让运动员远离毒品或酒精问题。

choices.text: Being super sports stars without appearing arrogant.
choices.zh: 成为超级体育明星而不显得傲慢。

items.stem: What does the speaker say about weddings?

choices.text: They always cost more than expected.
choices.zh: 婚礼的花费总是超出预期。

choices.text: They are joyous and exciting occasions.
choices.zh: 婚礼是欢乐和激动人心的场合。

choices.text: They should be paid up by the attendees.
choices.zh: 婚礼应该由参加者付费。

choices.text: They are dreams coming true to the brides.
choices.zh: 婚礼是新娘梦想成真的时刻。

items.stem: What do we learn about the wedding of the Canadian woman Susan?

choices.text: It cost $60,000.
choices.zh: 婚礼花费了60000美元。

choices.text: It was cancelled.
choices.zh: 婚礼被取消了。

choices.text: It had eight guests only.
choices.zh: 婚礼只有八位宾客。

choices.text: It was held in Las Vegas.
choices.zh: 婚礼在Las Vegas举行。

items.stem: What did Susan's maid of honor advise her to do?

choices.text: Postpone her wedding.
choices.zh: 推迟她的婚礼。

choices.text: Ask her friends for help.
choices.zh: 向她的朋友寻求帮助。

choices.text: Keep to her budget.
choices.zh: 遵守她的预算。

choices.text: Invite more guests.
choices.zh: 邀请更多宾客。

items.stem: How did Susan respond to her future husband's suggestion?

choices.text: She called it romantic.
choices.zh: 她称这个建议很浪漫。

choices.text: She welcomed it with open arms.
choices.zh: 她张开双臂欢迎这个建议。

choices.text: She said she would think about it.
choices.zh: 她说她会考虑一下。

choices.text: She rejected it flatly.
choices.zh: 她断然拒绝了。

items.stem: What has a new study revealed about temperature?

choices.text: It determines people's moods.
choices.zh: 它决定人们的心情。

choices.text: It can impact people's wellbeing.
choices.zh: 它会影响人们的幸福感。

choices.text: It is closely related to people's emotions.
choices.zh: 它与人们的情绪密切相关。

choices.text: It can influence people's personalities.
choices.zh: 它会影响人们的性格。

items.stem: What does the speaker say about warmer climates?

choices.text: They make people more reproductive.
choices.zh: 它们使人们更具生殖能力。

choices.text: They increase people's life expectancy.
choices.zh: 它们延长人们的预期寿命。

choices.text: They tend to produce positive feelings.
choices.zh: 它们往往会产生积极的情绪。

choices.text: They may alter people's genes gradually.
choices.zh: 它们可能会逐渐改变人们的基因。

items.stem: What did the online personality tests suggest?

choices.text: The link between temperature and personality is fairly weak.
choices.zh: 温度与性格之间的联系相当微弱。

choices.text: People share many personality traits despite their nationalities.
choices.zh: 尽管国籍不同,人们有许多共同的性格特征。

choices.text: People in the same geographical area may differ in personality.
choices.zh: 同一地理区域的人在性格上可能有所不同。

choices.text: The Americans are apparently more outgoing than the Chinese.
choices.zh: 美国人显然比中国人更外向。

items.stem: Why does the speaker say the finding of a new national poll reveals a serious problem?

choices.text: The number of older Americans living alone is on the rise.
choices.zh: 独居的美国老年人数量正在上升。

choices.text: Chronic loneliness does harm to senior citizens in particular.
choices.zh: 慢性孤独尤其对老年人造成伤害。

choices.text: Correlations have been found between loneliness and ill health.
choices.zh: 孤独与健康不佳之间已被发现存在关联。

choices.text: A growing number of US seniors face the risk of early mortality.
choices.zh: 越来越多的美国老年人面临早死的风险。

items.stem: What is the good news the speaker talks about?

choices.text: Medication is available for treating loneliness.
choices.zh: 有药物可用于治疗孤独。

choices.text: Loneliness rarely results from living alone.
choices.zh: 孤独很少是独居造成的。

choices.text: Being busy helps fight loneliness.
choices.zh: 忙碌有助于对抗孤独。

choices.text: Loneliness is probably reversible.
choices.zh: 孤独可能是可逆的。

items.stem: What is the key to solving the loneliness problem according to the speaker?

choices.text: Living with one's children.
choices.zh: 与子女同住。

choices.text: Meeting social expectations.
choices.zh: 满足社会期望。

choices.text: Meaningful social contact.
choices.zh: 有意义的社交接触。

choices.text: Timely medical intervention.
choices.zh: 及时的医疗干预。

items.stem: What do we learn about the speaker before she created the community We Are Travel Girls?

choices.text: She had a successful career in finance.
choices.zh: 她在金融领域有一份成功的职业。

choices.text: She wrote stories about women travelers.
choices.zh: 她撰写关于女性旅行者的故事。

choices.text: She made regular trips to Asian countries.
choices.zh: 她定期前往亚洲国家旅行。

choices.text: She invested in several private companies.
choices.zh: 她投资了几家私营公司。

items.stem: What did the speaker's friend suggest they do in 2015?

choices.text: Buy a ranch.
choices.zh: 购买一个牧场。

choices.text: Start a blog.
choices.zh: 创建一个博客。

choices.text: Travel round the world.
choices.zh: 环游世界。

choices.text: Set up a travel agency.
choices.zh: 成立一家旅行社。

items.stem: What does the speaker advise people to do if they want to become travel writers?

choices.text: Work hard to attract attention from publishers.
choices.zh: 努力工作以吸引出版商的关注。

choices.text: Gain support from travel advertising companies.
choices.zh: 获得旅游广告公司的支持。

choices.text: Try to find a full-time job in the travel business.
choices.zh: 尝试在旅游行业找到一份全职工作。

choices.text: Create something unique to enter the industry.
choices.zh: 创造独特的东西以进入该行业。

items.stem: What is the speaker's advice on winning a loyal audience?

choices.text: Attracting sufficient investment.
choices.zh: 吸引足够的投资。

choices.text: Creating an exotic corporate culture.
choices.zh: 创建一种异国情调的企业文化。

choices.text: Avoiding too much advertising early on.
choices.zh: 早期避免过多广告。

choices.text: Refraining from promoting similar products.
choices.zh: 避免推广类似产品。
